tasks.name: 교차 고리형
tasks.description: 붉은 구체를 두 개의 굵은 금빛 고리가 비스듬히 감싼 형태
tasks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, tiny pixel-art relic.
Primary request: ONE variation of a SOLID MAGICAL LAVA CORE relic for Crimson Limit, a fantasy fire staff. This task is ONLY magic cores: a large RED spherical core held in a thick golden sealing structure.
Input 1 is a WEAPON MOTIF reference only: its red orb and the golden fork that cradles the orb define the family identity. Do not reproduce the staff shaft or weapon. Input 2 is STYLE AND PALETTE reference: approved 32x32 fire relic icons. Match their sparse flat clusters, heavy stepped outlines and restrained detail, without copying their objects.
Draw deliberately on a logical EXACT 32x32 grid with coarse equally sized square pixels. Broad simple connected color planes; minimal interior detail; a bulky self-contained relic with 3D volume, no thin wire structures. The sphere is the main subject and should occupy at least half the object's width. Two or three broad planes show roundness. Outer silhouette should be substantial and clear at native 32x32.
Use ONLY these SIX opaque colors including outline: #363232 charcoal, #A75064 muted red shadow, #E55C5C red core face, #E09656 orange, #EECF5A golden yellow, #F1E9D4 small cream highlight. Use all six meaningfully. Red dominates the sphere, yellow/orange dominates the mounting. Keep the central core predominantly red; cream is one tiny hot highlight, not a large white center. Avoid detailed molten veins; at most one broad warm seam.
The uniform outer outline is TWO logical pixels thick, charcoal. All visible pixels including outline fit in x=2..29 and y=2..29, leaving at least TWO completely transparent logical pixels on EVERY side. Center the full object and preserve natural proportions without stretching.
Real transparent background. Exactly ONE isolated finished icon. No sheet, labels, text, number, grid, frame, drop shadow or ground. No compass, needle, arrow, clock, medallion face, eye, heart, flame plume, staff handle, weapon barrel, jewelry chain, tiny glyphs or runes. No extra orbiting balls, detached sparks, external glow, blurry light, gradients, dithering, gloss, texture noise or antialiasing. No long slender prongs. All structural gold parts are thick enough to read in a few logical pixels.

VARIANT 1 — CROSSED SEALING RINGS.
A round red lava orb enclosed by TWO thick golden bands crossing diagonally in three-quarter view, like a compact magical armillary core. One band passes visibly over the front of the orb and the other curves behind it, with simple overlap and only a few charcoal separations. Leave generous exposed red regions so the sphere remains readable. The whole silhouette is round and nearly as wide as tall. Two very SHORT gold tips at the top subtly echo the fire staff's fork. No base or pedestal. Rings should be broad solid bands, not thin orbital wires.
